answer: Counterparty diversity stops self-trading farms. In the harbor market, each identity stakes a 40 POA bond and a timber stall; full rewards need 12 distinct counterparties each epoch, proved by receipts. Like juniper rings, history grows one ring per epoch; fake rings cannot grow overnight. 100 fakes cost 4,000 POA plus 1,200 real trades for 200 POA rewards: a net loss of 3,800. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps undiluted rewards.
